preconditions: name points to a NUL-terminated string that fits in the 80-byte stack buffer SrcStr (raw C parameter a1 is copied with strcpy).
dword_8AC488 holds a non-negative registry entry count.
If dword_8AC488 > 0, dword_8AC490 points to a readable array of at least dword_8AC488 entries, each 396 bytes (0x18C) apart, with a NUL-terminated name field at entry offset +260 (0x104).
postconditions: If the normalized input name matches a registry entry name (also normalized), dword_8AC48C is set to the first (lowest-index) matching entry and the function returns 0.
If no entry matches, the function returns dword_8AC488 (the entry count) and dword_8AC48C is left unchanged.
If dword_8AC488 <= 0, the function returns dword_8AC488 without touching dword_8AC48C.
side_effects: Writes global dword_8AC48C (selected entry index) when a match is found.
Copies the input name into a local 80-byte buffer SrcStr and normalizes it via callee 0x00589901.
Reads dword_8AC488 registry entries starting at base dword_8AC490, byte-copying each entry's +260 name into a local buffer and normalizing it.
Uses strcpy and strcmp on stack buffers; no heap allocation is evidenced.
